ai_titawin_init = {
	class = "rl_binary_starting_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	flags = { empire_home_system theian_system }
	neighbor_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1 }
	neighbor_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	planet = {
		init_effect = {
			create_country = { name = "EMPIRE_DESIGN_lithoid_humans" type = default }
		}
	}
}

deneb_neighbor_t1_first_colony = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	flags = { neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t2 }
	}
}

deneb_system = {
	class = "sc_a"
	flags = { empire_home_system deneb_system }
	usage = custom_empire
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}

une_deneb_system = {
	class = "sc_a"
	flags = { empire_home_system deneb_system }
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = human_lost_colony_is_grs }
				NOT = {
					any_country = {
						has_country_flag = human_3
					}
				}
				any_country = {
					has_country_flag = human_1
					is_human_species = yes
					NOT = { has_origin = origin_lost_colony }
					NOT = { has_origin = origin_broken_shackles }
				}
				NOT = { any_system = { has_star_flag = deneb_system } }
				NOT = { has_star_flag = empire_cluster }
				num_ai_empires_setting >= 1

				add = 99999
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "NAME_Commonwealth_of_Man" type = default }
		spawn_system = { initializer = deneb_neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = deneb_neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}

une_vela_system = {
	class = "sc_binary_1"
	flags = { empire_home_system vela_system }
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				has_global_flag = human_lost_colony_is_grs
				any_country = {
					has_country_flag = human_1
					is_human_species = yes
					NOT = { has_origin = origin_lost_colony }
				}
				NOR = {
					any_system = { has_star_flag = vela_system }
					has_star_flag = empire_cluster
				}
				num_ai_empires_setting >= 1
				add = 99999
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "EMPIRE_DESIGN_humans3" type = default }
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}

vela_system = {
	class = "sc_binary_1"
	usage_odds = 0
	flags = { empire_home_system vela_system }
	usage = nomad_init
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}
